walkthroughs.body_html: A finish stops corrosion, protects from wear, improves grip and looks attractive. Unfinished mild steel rusts in days; an outdoor pine bench rots in a couple of years without sealing or varnishing.

Galvanising dips steel in molten zinc — perfect for outdoor structures. Anodising thickens the natural oxide on aluminium and accepts dyes for bright colours. Powder coating gives a tough, even finish on garden furniture.
A steel planter for the garden needs corrosion resistance. Galvanising gives long-term rust protection; a powder coat on top adds colour and extra protection — typical for high-end outdoor goods.
